consequence.statement: New optional warmup configuration is available; nothing changes for existing configurations.

original.statement: DestinationRule's LB trafficPolicy gains warmup configuration (duration, minimumPercent, aggression); this is an added optional capability with no operational consequence.

decision.reason: [ev-c2809b3da7db] only says Istio added support for a new warmup configuration (duration, minimumPercent, aggression) in DestinationRule's load-balancer trafficPolicy. It describes nothing that fails, gets rejected, stops being honoured or changes a default. So "none" (informational) is the right consequence for an operator who does nothing. The validators were inconclusive and contradict nothing here.
